name: TableCell
description: A table data cell (<td>) for the Table family. align controls text alignment; numeric right-aligns with tabular figures so columns line up on the decimal.

usage.description: TableCell is the body cell of the Table family: plain tabular data with an optional numeric mode that aligns figures on the decimal. Header semantics belong to TableHeaderCell; TableCell never announces scope.

ariaRequirements: native <td> semantics; no ARIA of its own
pairs with TableHeaderCell scope=col/row so cells inherit column and row context
a11y.reviewedNote: 2026-07-27 — native td; alignment and numeric tabular figures verified; axe asserted inside a table in the unit test. 2026-08-04 — Phase 1 pass: light/dark/forced-colors verified in a real browser; axe clean across all stories x 3 modes; AT-tree and real-browser forced-colors evidence captured; keyboard sort cycle and selection driven by play stories at the Table composition level.

dense: table td; align start/center/end, numeric = tabular figures right-aligned
forbiddenUse: render it outside a table row
use it for a header — use TableHeaderCell so column/row context is announced
